title: Register Tokens for Bounded-State Reasoning in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.16372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked tokens with bidirectional attention. Extending reasoning across generation chunks normally requires keeping earlier generated text in context. We ask whether a dLLM can instead continue reasoning after that text is cleared, using only a fixed-size carried state. We implement this state as a small number of register tokens: dedicated fixed-position tokens whose continuous hidden states are trained to carry reasoning progress across generation chunks. We post-train dLLMs to decode a chunk of text, clear it while preserving the register values, and continue decoding from the prompt and carried state. In our main comparisons on LLaDA and Dream, registers outperform discrete-text carry on every benchmark, with gains of up to 8.5 points on math and 19.5 points on code. translated_title: 用于扩散语言模型中有界状态推理的寄存器令牌
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型通过以双向注意力对掩码令牌进行迭代去噪来生成文本。跨生成块扩展推理通常需要将先前生成的文本保留在上下文中。我们探讨这样一个问题：dLLM能否在清除该文本后继续推理，仅依赖一个固定大小的携带状态。我们将该状态实现为少量的寄存器令牌：专用的固定位置令牌，其连续隐藏状态经过训练，用于在生成块之间承载推理进度。我们对dLLM进行后训练，使其解码一段文本，在保留寄存器值的同时将其清除，然后从提示和携带状态继续解码。在LLaDA和Dream上的主要比较中，寄存器在所有基准测试中均优于离散文本携带方式，在数学任务上获得高达8.5分的提升，在代码任务上获得高达19.5分的提升。寄存器在有界代码生成中尤为有效，因为正确的程序通常较短，紧凑的携带状态足以承载推理进度。
tldr: 该论文提出用少量寄存器令牌作为固定大小的携带状态，使扩散语言模型在清除已生成文本后仍能继续推理，在数学和代码基准上分别比保留离散文本的方式提升高达8.5分和19.5分。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes register tokens as a fixed-size carried state that enables diffusion language models to continue reasoning after clearing generated text, outperforming discrete-text carry by up to 8.5 points on math and 19.5 points on code benchmarks.
